fields.name: SqlParameterCollectionExtensions table-valued parameter mapping
fields.description: The structured input shape emitted by SqlParameterCollectionExtensions for table-valued parameter helpers.

members.name: parameterName
members.description: SQL Server parameter name, normalized to begin with @.

members.name: sqlType
members.description: Structured SQL Server type for a table-valued input.

members.name: direction
members.description: Table-valued parameters are emitted as input.

members.name: rows
members.description: Rows supplied directly or materialized from models, keyed models, or virtual compound keys. Absent (a null parameter Value) when the source collection is null or yields zero rows; never System.DBNull.Value and never an empty enumeration, which the driver rejects.

members.name: columns
members.description: Column names and SQL types used by keyed-model and virtual compound-key overloads.

representations.csharp: SqlParameter(SqlDbType.Structured) whose Value is the supplied SqlDataRecord rows or a list constructed in the source iteration order, or a null reference when there are no rows.
